description: A React wallet adapter for the Cosmos ecosystem.

# CosmosKit Documentation

CosmosKit is a wallet adapter for developers to build apps that quickly and easily interact with Cosmos blockchains and wallets. It provides a set of hooks and components to help you integrate Cosmos functionality into your application.

## Getting Started

To get started with CosmosKit, follow the [How to use CosmosKit](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/get-started) guide.

## Examples

Runnable example projects showing CosmosKit hooks in action live in the [`examples/`](https://github.com/hyperweb-io/cosmos-kit/tree/main/examples) directory of the repo:

- [Next.js Pages Router example](https://github.com/hyperweb-io/cosmos-kit/tree/main/examples/cosmos-kit-nextjs-pages-router-example)
- [Next.js App Router example](https://github.com/hyperweb-io/cosmos-kit/tree/main/examples/cosmos-kit-nextjs-app-router-example)
- [Next.js lite example](https://github.com/hyperweb-io/cosmos-kit/tree/main/examples/cosmos-kit-lite-nextjs-pages-router-example)

## Hooks

CosmosKit provides several hooks to help you interact with the Cosmos ecosystem:

- [useChain](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/hooks/use-chain)
- [useChainWallet](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/hooks/use-chain-wallet)
- [useManager](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/hooks/use-manager)
- [useModalTheme](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/hooks/use-modal-theme)
- [useNameService](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/hooks/use-name-service)
- [useWallet](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/hooks/use-wallet)

## Packages

CosmosKit consists of several packages:

- [@cosmos-kit/core](https://github.com/hyperweb-io/cosmos-kit/blob/main/packages/core/LICENSE): Core package of CosmosKit, including types, utils, and base classes.
- [@cosmos-kit/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cosmos-kit/react): A wallet adapter for React with mobile WalletConnect support for the Cosmos ecosystem.
- [examples](https://github.com/hyperweb-io/cosmos-kit/tree/main/examples): Example Next.js projects integrating the `@cosmos-kit/react` wallet adapter.

## Wallet Developers

If you're a wallet developer and want to integrate new wallets into CosmosKit, follow the [How to integrate new wallets into CosmosKit](https://docs.hyperweb.io/cosmos-kit/integrating-wallets/adding-new-wallets) guide.

- [Official Website](https://hyperweb.io/)
